why: The statement asks for BSD in full (all curves, all ranks; rank, leading term, Sha), so every restricted result is at most a case. The OpenAI family-002 claim covers only curves with some Selmer corank <=1, which excludes all rank >=2 curves: case, unreviewed, and doubtful given internal scope tension, deferred steps and unreviewed companions. The companions (B, C, 004, 006 2-converse) each settle rank/Sha or 2-part for a subclass: case. AI role is generated for the OpenAI events because the release says the results were produced by the model and no human author is credited. Human cases: BSTW (2024, unreviewed), Burungale-Tian (Annals, digested). Self-published full-proof claims are whole in scope but not_credible on multiple F10 signals. Smith, Banwait-Huang, Li (conditional, other field), ML/murmuration and expository papers are none; the twelve-curve numerical check is instances.
